name: Hatsufuji Shizuku
source:
Akari's daughter from her first marriage, she is a 3rd year student attending an all girls' school whose grades are in the upper middle margin.
Even though she has a dainty figure her boobs are huge which comes across as an imbalance to her appearance. Her grades aren't that good but she doesn't actually dislike studying, in fact she is a good listener and a fast learner so she makes the ideal student.

She is holding off on taking entrance exams while being tutored by Nozumu and while she thinks he is a great teacher and an amusing conversationalist, she isn't really conscious of him as a man.
